title: Dashboard Shell — one responsive shell + mobile dock
description: The single dashboard chrome: persistent collapsible rail + topbar on desktop; on mobile there is NO sidebar at all — the same nav ships as a bottom dock plus a MobileMenuDrawer of thumbnail TILES (drill-down one level for sub-items), so a phone never gets a sheet-shaped copy of the desktop list. ONE `nav` prop (groups → items → one level of sub-items) is the SSOT for all three faces — flag `dock: true` on the items you want docked, or it takes the first few. Slots for everything project-specific: sidebarHeader (workspace switcher), sidebarFooter (user menu), actions (search/notifications), topbar (full replace), secondary (narrow contextual column = the old three-column 'advanced' archetype). Breakpoints are shadcn's Sidebar hook plus a `md:hidden` dock — no viewport measuring in your code, no hydration flash. Zero backend: pass `activePath` to drive it from state, or let it read usePathname().
